items.title: BLAS kernel for the second program's calibration import
items.what: The second program's X import (recount/rc_x_cross_v13.py --calib import) stopped twice with a segmentation fault inside OpenBLAS: the 2000 x 2000 matrix product of the A10 sec. 2.6 Monte Carlo level check (rc_core_v13.mc_levels), with OPENBLAS_CORETYPE forced to Haswell on the pod's AMD Ryzen 9 7950X. It was re-run with OPENBLAS_CORETYPE=SkylakeX, the library's own autodetected kernel on that CPU. The product is of integer counts and 0/1 flags (exact in float64 under any kernel), so no value depends on the kernel; the crashed runs wrote no output. Both programs agree on all 40 X keys, levels included.
